elaine: Hey team, thanks for joining todays all-hands. Quick roundup + action items from the live Q&A thread. Recording & notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/all-hands/2026-03.

elaine: Actions (react with ✅ if you own):
- Prospect SLA language -> @sam
- Burst capacity price samples + calculator -> @mika
- Private deploy ETA + compliance checklist -> @devon
- 8-bit/quant migration guide -> @jun
- Eval/regression alert owner needed -> @devex

mika: For burst pricing, do we want examples for both committed monthly and pay-as-you-go?

sam: Yes. I'll draft example: 2k req/min baseline, 5k req/min burst 1h. Will show cost delta.

devon: I'll own Private deploy ETA. Creating INF-4332 with KMS/network/OPA checklist and pinging legal for certs.

jun: Need a quick benchmark bucket: 13B fp16 vs int8 latency on A100. I can assemble commands once someone drops baseline numbers.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Recording uploaded (48m). https://internal.redwood/ah-recordings/1945678902.mp4

amber: Recommend 30m cross-team triage tomorrow to align SLA/pricing/compliance. I can coordinate.

elaine: @amber schedule 10:30am PT tomorrow and add a short agenda. Everyone listed, please post a one-line acceptance here when you pick up the item.

mika: Taking burst pricing. Will add spreadsheet + small JS calculator. ETA EOD Friday.

sam: Adding SLA draft to notes now.

devon: INF-4332: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4332  assigned to me, ETA next Tue for checklist.

jun: I'll post a gist later today with `nb` and commands. Sample: `./bench_run.sh --model redwood-13b --precision int8 --batch 1 --seq 512`

elaine: Clarification from Q&A: "unchanged dev experience" means API/console parity for core routes (generation, embeddings). Infra-specific knobs will exist. Use this phrasing if flagged to customers.

mika: Noted, adding to pricing FAQ.

amber: Calendar invite sent (tomorrow 10:30am PT).

elaine: If you referenced a slide during Q&A that needs more context, drop slide# + 1-line note here and I'll append to the public notes.

sam: slide 14  SLA examples need clearer failure modes; I'll add snippet.

devon: slide 22  Private deploy network diagram missing NAT gateway step; attaching update to INF-4332.

jun: slide 9  benchmark numbers were synthetic; adding caveat.

elaine: Thanks all. React with ✅ after you post your confirmation so we can close and move items into tickets.
